title: Integrability of a polynomial times an affine polynomial evaluation
statement: Let $p,q\in\mathbb R[X]$ and $a,b\in\mathbb R$. The function $y\mapsto q(y)p(a+by)$ is integrable under the standard Gaussian probability measure on $\mathbb R$.
